title: Nebius Group (NBIS) Is Up 21.3% After AI21 Labs Deal Talks Surface - What's Changed
title_zh: AI21 Labs 交易谈判浮出水面后，Nebius Group (NBIS) 上涨 21.3% - 发生了什么变化
summary: In early April 2026, reports indicated that Dutch AI cloud provider Nebius Group N.V. was in acquisition talks with Israeli AI21 Labs, an AI company previously valued at US$1.40 billion and backed by investors such as Pitango, Intel Capital, Google, and Nvidia.
summary_zh: 2026 年 4 月上旬，有报道称，荷兰人工智能云提供商 Nebius Group N.V. 正在与以色列 AI21 Labs 进行收购谈判，该公司是一家人工智能公司，此前估值为 14 亿美元，并得到了 Pitango、英特尔资本、谷歌和 Nvidia 等投资者的支持。

title: Cadence Google Cloud AI Deal Tests Rich Valuation And Growth Story
title_zh: Cadence 谷歌云 AI 交易测试丰富的估值和增长故事
summary: Cadence Design Systems (NasdaqGS:CDNS) announced a collaboration with Google to connect its ChipStack AI Super Agent and EDA engines with Google’s Gemini models on Google Cloud.
summary_zh: Cadence Design Systems（纳斯达克股票代码：CDNS）宣布与 Google 合作，将其 ChipStack AI Super Agent 和 EDA 引擎与 Google Cloud 上的 Google Gemini 模型连接起来。

title: How NVIDIA Optics Deal and New AI Facility Will Impact Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Investors
title_zh: NVIDIA 光学交易和新的人工智能设施将如何影响 Lumentum Holdings (LITE) 投资者
summary: Lumentum Holdings recently announced multiyear agreements with NVIDIA, a very large US$2 billion investment in advanced optics, and plans for a new 240,000-square-foot Greensboro, North Carolina facility to produce indium phosphide-based optical devices for AI data centers.
summary_zh: Lumentum Holdings 最近宣布与 NVIDIA 达成多年协议，这是对先进光学领域的 20 亿美元巨额投资，并计划在北卡罗来纳州格林斯博罗新建一座占地 240,000 平方英尺的工厂，为 AI 数据中心生产基于磷化铟的光学器件。

title: The Dealmaking 3: NBA on Prime, Fab Five Return, Sportradar’s Brazil Expansion
title_zh: 交易 3：NBA Prime、五虎回归、Sportradar 的巴西扩张
summary: Watch The Dealmaking 3 of the Week: This week of The Dealmaking 3 with “The Sports Professor” Rick Horrow features Michigan’s “Fab Five” reuniting for a special Final Four alternate broadcast on truTv and HBO Max, Amazon.com, Inc.
summary_zh: 观看本周的《The Dealmaking 3》：本周《体育教授》里克·霍罗 (Rick Horrow) 主持的《The Dealmaking 3》将介绍密歇根州的“五虎”重聚，在 truTv 和 HBO Max、Amazon.com, Inc. 上进行特别的四强轮流直播。

title: What to Expect From Nvidia in the Coming Months? Taiwan Semiconductor Just Offered Investors a Clue.
title_zh: 未来几个月对 Nvidia 有何期待？台积电刚刚为投资者提供了线索。
summary: Some investors wonder whether Nvidia can maintain revenue momentum.
summary_zh: 一些投资者想知道英伟达能否保持营收势头。
